title: Study and tool orientation
learner: Returning learners who need a manageable study routine and reliable use of notation, calculator settings and saved files.
assumedKnowledge: Basic reading and arithmetic; use F01/F04 for underlying numeric or trigonometric gaps.

include: Retrieve, check, and plan the next session
Read technical text and decode notation
Check calculator settings and expression entry
Organize files and verify a recoverable copy
exclude: University enrollment or credit decisions, numerical study-habit mastery, mental-health treatment, a universal ideal review interval, paid tools, account setup, arbitrary expression execution, device-specific calculator certification and automatic backup scheduling.

routes.quick: Use four scenario judgments, read Quick recall, then produce a fresh self-checked record for each objective. Use the calculator and file checks to verify tool behavior.
routes.full: Perform retrieval and plan a return; read and paraphrase technical conditions; predict and check calculator behavior; save/reopen a practice file and plan progress recovery.

overlap.reuse: Keep exact/approximate, grouping and scientific-notation conventions consistent. F12 focuses on reading and entering them, not duplicate numerical mastery.
Use existing degree/radian and unit-circle conventions; link full explanations for first-time trigonometry.
Carry units and model limits into tool checks; reuse practical record schemas and components.

assessment.diagnostic: Four unscored choice judgments, one per objective, with misconception feedback and direct lesson targets.
assessment.independent: Four substantive written fields and three self-check criteria per objective. Generated tasks have at least three distinct structures per lesson. File objective requires actually saving/reopening the harmless exercise and reporting the observed comparison.
assessment.assistance: Guided comparisons and labs are practice. Revealing the active task review persists its assisted label; a fresh task preserves the last completed record. Confidence, visits and tool interactions never create completion.
assessment.evidence: Versioned practical artifacts and completion timestamps, self-checked. No numerical evidence or course completion changes. No automated semantic judgment.

sharedCapabilities.interface: Reuse PracticalLesson, PracticalPath, PracticalTask, PracticalWorkspace, ordinary notes and existing backup APIs.
sharedCapabilities.change: Add F12 entries to the scoped practical catalog and availability; existing route dispatch already supports them.

Scoped practical reader chooses local unscored activity. F11 keeps its required internal engineering model type; nonnumeric study/file tasks do not invent numeric model results. No persisted envelope or progress schema changes.

sharedCapabilities.interface: Bounded calculatorCheck(function, mode, inputPreset) and groupingCheck(case), with prediction feedback; no eval or arbitrary user code.
sharedCapabilities.change: Pure utility plus client view, numbers checked against independent analytic benchmarks and Taylor-series oracle.

sharedCapabilities.interface: Synthetic practice file {format:'ece-study-file-practice-v1',revision,marker,note}; generate local download and validate selected file under 20 KB.
sharedCapabilities.change: No network upload or progress import. Reject wrong format, malformed JSON and marker/content mismatch; link existing Settings to actual progress backup.

verification: Strict plans/content/links/complete objective coverage; all inline math renders.
100 seeds per lesson cover all three scenario structures, deterministic outputs and sensible constraints; independent oracles check passage arithmetic, unit-circle values, grouping and notation.
Actual file download/read/compare, invalid JSON, wrong format, mismatch and size limits; no numerical evidence from tools.
Every practical objective: draft save/reload, assisted label, fresh independent record, retained completion, notes, export/reset/import, two-tab conflict and corrupt-record recovery.
Desktop/mobile all pages plus active tool states, keyboard, Axe, overflow, console errors and visual review.
Run full tests including CPython, lint, types and production build on owned worktree; isolated 3102 browser tests, 3002 preview. Label preview only afterward; human review pending.
